issue.title: [Bug]: trackALAlertsInGitHub fails on the upload sarif file step
issue.body:
### AL-Go version

preview

### Describe the issue

trackALAlertsInGitHub is failing on the upload sarif file step:
https://github.com/microsoft/MyApps/actions/runs/181080738481

### Expected behavior

It should upload the sarif file and display the warnings on the PR

### Steps to reproduce

- Enable trackALAlertsInGitHub
- Run a CI/CD
- Open a Pull Request that introduces a new warning

### Additional context (logs, screenshots, etc.)
```
  ##[debug]response status: 202
  Successfully uploaded results
  ::endgroup::
::group::Waiting for processing to finish
Waiting for processing to finish
  Analysis upload status is failed.
  ::endgroup::
Error: Code Scanning could not process the submitted SARIF file:
SARIF URI scheme "c" did not match the checkout URI scheme "file"
```

notes: Complete report with a decisive error message. The SARIF URI scheme mismatch is a path-handling defect in AL-Go's own code analysis log processing (ProcessALCodeAnalysisLogs), which is why the area is al-go with HIGH confidence. Scores whether the agent recognises that a Windows drive-letter path leaked into a file: URI. Medium risk: on the CI path but not in shared or template code. Also checks the agent does not ask for logs when logs are already present.
